core_idea: The Middle Little Brother Sinclair is a Tank / Status Specialist — **Envy Resonance** kit — queue Envy-affinity skills across the team; at **4+ Envy Absolute Resonance** a Combat Start Counter (**Payback with Interest**) fires for free. Offense Level also scales with the highest Resonance that turn. Scaling conditions: Coin Power +1 per 6 Bleed (max +2).
playstyle_guide:
- Skills check **6+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Front-load **+5 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Pair high-Aggro turns with Guard or Assist Defense so passives trigger under pressure.
- At Combat Start at 6+ Envy Resonance, **Counter: Warmup in the East** can fire **Payback with Interest** as a Counter instead of a normal defensive clash — the defense slot is your burst tool, not just protection.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Coin Power +1 per 6 Bleed (max +2).

**S1 — Is it You?!** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If target has 6+ Bleed, Coin Power +1 | [On Use] Gain +5 Aggro to this Skill Slot next turn.
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits

**S2 — Payback with Interest** (BP 4, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If target has 6+ Bleed, Coin Power +1 | [On Use] Gain +5 Aggro to this Skill Slot next turn.
- draws enemy aggro — intended to absorb hits
- At 4+ Reson. that includes this Skill, deal +15% damage

**S3 — Write 'em all down** (BP 5, CP +4, x3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / High stacked).
- Deal +1% damage for every 1 Book of Vengeance — Sinclair — (max 30%) ; Coin Power +1 for every 6 Bleed on target (max 2) ; [Combat Start] This Skill gains (highest Reson. / 2) Offense Level (max 3, rounded down) ; - If the said Reson. includes an A-Reson., double the Offense Level gained from the above effect
- **Coin Power** scales with **Bleed** (+1 per 6, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Deal +2.5% damage for every Reson. that includes this Skill (max 15%); Deal +7.5% damage for every 10 Book of Vengeance — Sinclair — (max 22.5%)

Combat passive — **The Middle Never Forgets**: When hit by an enemy, inflict 5 Vendetta Mark against the attacker(or Part) (once per turn).
  - When another ally is hit by an enemy, inflict 2 Vendetta Mark against the attacker(or Part) (once per turn per Identity).
  - If the said ally is from , inflict 3 additional Vendetta Mark.

Combat passive — **We've Got Your Back**: Combat Start: 1 ally with the least current HP percentage gains 2 Defense Level Up.
  - If the said ally is from , also gain 2 Offense Level Up.

Defense skill — **Counter: Warmup in the East**: [Combat Start] Skill behavior changes based on the sum of Envy A-Reson.:.
  - At 4+ sum of A-Reson., use 'Payback with Interest' as Counter.
  - At 6+ sum of A-Reson., use 'Write 'em all down' as Counter.
  - (Activates from the leftmost Skill Slot. Activates 2 times per turn).
